text: {"assertions":["A double counting bug in analytics/etl/rollup.sql caused daily rollup totals to exceed source table values.","The bug was discovered after a client had already retried the process once.","An off-by-one error in a slice bound was identified as the root cause.","The fix corrected the slice bound and added a property test in PR #5327 on branch fix/double-counting-1.","A flaky test improved from 31 failures per 100 runs to zero failures following the fix.","The bug could be reproduced by rerunning the rollup for a day that was already loaded.","This issue was located in the same area of analytics/etl/rollup.sql as earlier double counting work."]}
